annotations.title: Create a timesheet link for a client

description: Freeze the hours of a date range (optionally one client or project) into a private link a client can open without an account, read, print and approve. The link shows hours and, unless include_notes is false, the work descriptions; never rates or amounts. Anyone with the link can read it until it expires, so confirm the range, the client and whether to include notes with the user before calling. The link is returned only once: pass it on to the user. Not available on demo accounts.

client.description: Only this client: id or exact name

expires_in_days.description: How long the link works: 7, 30, 90 days (default 30)

include_notes.description: Show the work descriptions to the client (default true)

project.description: Only this project: id or "Client / Project"

title.description: A heading for the sheet (default: client and dates)

name: share_timesheet

url.description: The private link to send to the client. Shown only once
